mapper.select: SELECT cycle_id FROM hr_appraisal_cycle WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT result.employee_id FROM hr_appraisal_result result JOIN hr_employee employee ON employee.id = result.employee_id AND employee.tenant_id = result.tenant_id AND employee.deleted = 0 WHERE result.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND result.cycle_id = #{cycleId}
ORDER BY result.employee_id

SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND dept_id SELECT id FROM hr_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND id SELECT id FROM hr_job_level WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND id SELECT id FROM hr_employee WHERE 1 = 0 AND id
IN #{identifier}

SELECT response.id AS responseId, invitation.id AS invitationId, invitation.evaluatee_id AS employeeId, invitation.evaluator_id AS evaluatorEmployeeId, invitation.evaluator_source AS source, invitation.version AS invitationVersion, response.score, response.submit_time AS submitTime FROM hr_performance_objective objective JOIN hr_perf_evaluator invitation ON invitation.tenant_id = objective.tenant_id AND invitation.objective_id = objective.id JOIN hr_perf_evaluator_response response ON response.tenant_id = invitation.tenant_id AND response.evaluator_id = invitation.id AND response.objective_id = invitation.objective_id AND response.evaluatee_id = invitation.evaluatee_id AND response.evaluator_source = invitation.evaluator_source WHERE objective.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND objective.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND objective.deleted = 0 AND invitation.evaluatee_id = #{employeeId} AND invitation.deleted = 0 AND invitation.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND response.deleted = 0 ORDER BY invitation.id, response.id

SELECT employee.id FROM hr_employee employee JOIN sys_user account ON account.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND account.user_id = employee.user_id WHERE employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.user_id = #{userId} AND employee.deleted = 0 AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0'

choose.when: SELECT dept_id AS identifier, dept_name AS name FROM sys_dept WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' ORDER BY dept_id
SELECT id AS identifier, position_name AS name FROM hr_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id AS identifier, level_name AS name FROM hr_job_level WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY level_rank, id
choose.otherwise: SELECT id AS identifier, name FROM hr_employee WHERE 1 = 0

mapper.select:
SELECT employee.id AS employeeId, employee.name AS employeeName, employee.employee_no AS employeeNo, employee.dept_id AS deptId, employee.position_id AS positionId, position.level_id AS jobLevelId, employee.user_id AS userId, employee.update_time AS updateTime FROM hr_employee employee LEFT JOIN hr_position position ON position.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND position.id = employee.position_id WHERE employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.deleted = 0 AND employee.employee_status IN ('ACTIVE','REGULAR','PROBATION','INTERN','ON_LEAVE','TRANSFERRED') AND employee.hire_date <= #{today} AND (employee.resign_date IS NULL OR employee.resign_date > #{today})
AND (employee.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR employee.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY employee.id

SELECT account.user_id AS identifier, account.nick_name AS name FROM sys_user account WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.user_id IN #{identifier} ORDER BY account.user_id
